rationale.A: ~930 m in traffic along the harbour (Laivasillankatu and Eteläranta, mostly with tram rails), then Kaisaniemi park and the rail-side path
rationale.B: ~1.6 km in mixed traffic on Vauhtitie, Veturitie, Pasilankatu and Helsinginkatu; 10 lights
rationale.C: Quiet Ullanlinna/Kaartinkaupunki streets, then Kaisaniemi park and the rail-side path; no mixed traffic; 3 lights; +1 min at most
rationale.D: Same start as C, then Töölönlahti, Olympic area and Central Park; car-free but 4 unsignalised crossings
rationale.E: No mixed traffic, but nearly all on tracks beside harbour streets (Pohjoisranta, Laivasillankatu, Eläintarhantie); 8 lights
rationale.G: Harbour-side tracks plus 210 m on Fleminginkatu with tram rails; 14 lights
rationale.H: Quiet Punavuori streets and Annankatu, then Linnunlauluntie and park paths; 7 lights and unsignalised Simonkatu/Kansakoulukatu crossings

notes: C removes A's tier-E harbour stretch at essentially no time cost, so it gets the calm card. C has 3 lights against A's 4, which is too small a saving for a fewest-lights card. D is about as calm as C.
